title: I have created my own editor for simple special effects for my Godot games
author: Keln
selftext:
**How does it work**

You can either draw or just directly tell the agent what to do. I have built a harness that understand the context of what you ask and what for, the theme for your project (in this case, pixel art cartoony game). From there, the agent (in this case, connected locally to my Claude code subscription with Fable 5.1) build the animation and lets you preview it in editor, editing whatever you need with procedural controls created for you per element.

UI is a little barebone, I just needed something very simple to just easily create effects, modify then with agents, and fast editing and export to the game, it just fasten my workflow a lot.

All sprites/art generated here its coming from just Claude, not connecting to image generation services or anything like that, just using the same sub I'm using for coding and its able to get very nice simple effects for 2D/3D low maintenance games.
